030package dev.visdb.seesaw;
031
032import java.util.Optional;
033
034import dev.visdb.seesaw.models.Item1;
035
036/**
037 * A ComboBox that only has a single displayValue.
038 * See {@link SsComboBox2} for documentation.
039 *
040 * @param <K> key type
041 * @param <D> displayValue type
042 */
043@SuppressWarnings("serial")
044public class SsComboBox1<K, D> extends SsComboBox2<K, D, Object> {
045  /**
046   * Builder; see {@link SsComboBox2.Builder}.
047   * @param <K>
048   * @param <D>
049   * @param <T>
050   */
051  public abstract static class AbstractBuilder<K, D, T extends AbstractBuilder<K, D, T>>
052      extends SsComboBox2.AbstractBuilder<K, D, Object, T> {}
053
054  /**
055   * Builder.
056   * @param <K>
057   * @param <D>
058   */
059  public static class Builder<K, D> extends AbstractBuilder<K, D, Builder<K, D>> {
060    /** self type idiom */
061    @Override
062    protected Builder<K, D> self() {
063      return this;
064    }
065
066    /** create SsComboBox1 */
067    @Override
068    public SsComboBox1<K, D> build() {
069      return new SsComboBox1<>(this);
070    }
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * @param builder
075   */
076  protected SsComboBox1(AbstractBuilder<K, D, ?> builder) {
077    super(builder);
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Creates an object of ComboBox with type params of Object.
082   * Default: see {@link SsComboBox2}.
083   */
084  // TODO: this fails because "K" is not concrete.
085  public SsComboBox1() {
086    this(new SsComboBox1.Builder<>() {});
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Return a copy of the chosenItem with methods getKey(), getDisplayValue().
091   */
092  @Override
093  public Item1<K, D> getChosenItem() {
094    Optional<Item1<K, D>> item = getChosenItem((remodel, lItem) -> {
095      return new Item1<>(remodel.getKey(lItem), remodel.getDisplayValue(lItem));
096    });
097    return item.orElse(new Item1<>(null, null));
098  }
099}
